I am satisfied with exploring its currently listed uses rather than chasing the remaining window and mat. Smoke felt like a dead-end discovery; Table has no offered use yet. No resource sacrifice or dilemma was apparent.

report.experience: Ink acted as reusable pigment for a letter and a printing block. The paper-making and printing chain was predictable, with a useful distinction between writing once and printing many. I followed available combinations without getting stuck; this was routine construction, not a resource dilemma. Stopped at chapter readiness. Visual layout, touch, human elapsed time and human enjoyment are not established.

report.experience: The plant-record task had a clear two-branch construction: preserved specimens became Herbarium, magnification became Leaf study, and Ink converted that study to a drawing for Illustrated flora. I reused my prior knowledge of Ink plus Paper rather than repeating it. The notable surprise was Ink disappearing here after remaining through both previous uses; there was no explanation visible. Stopped at chapter readiness. No command syntax confusion. Actual visual layout, touch, human elapsed time and human enjoyment are unknown.
